caption_L1: This area plot is titled Total number of employed persons in Canada from 2000 to 2019 (in millions). The y-axis shows Employment in millions with a linear scale from 0 to 20. There is a linear scale with a minimum of 2000 and a maximum of 2015 on the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: The year 2000 had the lowest employment rate. This then went up every year with the exception of the year 2007 to 2008 when the rate dropped slightly. It then went up every year after that.
